quizName:
DMV Practice Test  #4
										  					
  

37 Questions • Passing Score 32

questions.question: Where should a driver not pass another vehicle?

options.text: On a curve in the roadway.

questions.correctAnswerText: All of the above.
questions.explanation: Do not pass another vehicle at a railroad crossing, in an intersection, on a curve, or on a hill. You cannot see far enough ahead in these places. Only pass when it is legal and safe.

questions.question: Which of the following commonly causes traffic accidents?

options.text: Not paying attention to the road.
Driving too fast for the conditions.

questions.correctAnswerText: All of the above.
questions.explanation: Driving too fast causes many crashes. Not paying attention can cause you to hit other vehicles. Most rear-end collisions happen because drivers follow too closely.

questions.question: This sign means:

options.text: Yield when turning left on a green light.

questions.correctAnswerText: Yield when turning left on a green light.
questions.explanation: This sign tells drivers to yield when turning left at a green light. You must let oncoming traffic pass first. You can turn left when it is safe.

questions.question: This road sign means:

options.text: You must drive at exactly this speed.
The highest speed you can legally drive is 55 mph.
You must drive through the intersection at this speed.

questions.correctAnswerText: The highest speed you can legally drive is 55 mph.
questions.explanation: This is a speed limit sign. It shows the fastest speed allowed on this road. In bad weather like rain, snow, or ice, you should drive slower than the posted limit.

questions.question: On a freeway, you realize you missed your turn or exit. You should:

options.text: Make the turn quickly from your lane.
Keep driving until you reach the next turn, exit, or safe place to turn around.
Signal other drivers to stop so you can turn.

questions.correctAnswerText: Keep driving until you reach the next turn, exit, or safe place to turn around.
questions.explanation: If you miss your turn or exit, do not back up. Drive to the next turn or exit where you can safely turn around. Backing up on a freeway or shoulder is illegal.

questions.question: Passing is prohibited:
questions.correctAnswerText: All of the above.
questions.explanation: You cannot pass another vehicle on hills, curves, at intersections, or at railroad crossings. These are unsafe and illegal places to pass.

questions.question: When stopped for a traffic violation or equipment check, the driver must show:
questions.correctAnswerText: All of the above.
questions.explanation: When stopped, you must show your driver's license, proof of registration, and proof of insurance. You must carry all three documents in your vehicle when driving.

questions.question: This sign means:

options.text: Traffic is merging from the right.

questions.correctAnswerText: Traffic is merging from the right.
questions.explanation: This sign warns you that traffic is merging into your lane from the right.

questions.question: When it starts to sleet or snow, you should:

options.text: Keep your windshield and mirrors clean.
Leave more space between you and the vehicle ahead.
Be careful around all other vehicles.

questions.correctAnswerText: All of the above.
questions.explanation: In snow and sleet, keep your windshield and mirrors clean so you can see well. Increase the distance between your car and other cars because slippery roads make it take longer to stop.

questions.question: Your brake lights tell other drivers that you:
questions.correctAnswerText: Are slowing down or stopping.
questions.explanation: Your brake lights show other drivers that you are slowing down or stopping. Your brake lights must work when you drive on any road.

questions.question: If you miss your exit on an interstate highway, what should you do?

options.text: Get off at the next exit and return to the exit you missed.
Roll down your window and ask another driver for help.

questions.correctAnswerText: Get off at the next exit and return to the exit you missed.
questions.explanation: Do not back up or turn around on the highway if you miss your exit. Instead, go to the next exit and safely turn around.

questions.question: What colors are the signs that show the distance to the next highway exit?
questions.correctAnswerText: Green with white letters
questions.explanation: Highway information signs are green with white letters or symbols.

questions.question: If you drink alcohol at a social event, what is the safest way to get home?

options.text: Get a ride from a friend who has not been drinking.
Take a cold shower before you drive.
Wait 30 minutes after drinking before you drive.

questions.correctAnswerText: Get a ride from a friend who has not been drinking.
questions.explanation: The safest way to avoid impaired driving is to arrange a ride from a sober friend. Coffee and cold showers do not reduce alcohol in your blood. It takes about one hour for your body to eliminate one drink.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.correctAnswerText: Crossroad ahead.
questions.explanation: Warning signs are usually yellow with black markings. They alert drivers to upcoming road conditions and hazards. This sign warns you that an intersection is coming.

questions.question: When you see this sign, what must you do?

options.text: Stop completely and check for pedestrians and cross traffic.
Stop completely and wait for a green light.
Slow down and check for traffic.

questions.correctAnswerText: Stop completely and check for pedestrians and cross traffic.
questions.explanation: An eight-sided sign is a stop sign. You must come to a complete stop and look for pedestrians and vehicles crossing. Wait until the intersection is clear before you go.

questions.question: What does alcohol do to your driving ability?

options.text: Slows your reflexes and reaction time.

questions.correctAnswerText: Slows your reflexes and reaction time.
questions.explanation: Alcohol slows brain activity and reduces the skills needed for safe driving. It slows your reaction time and impairs your judgment.

questions.question: A person walking with a white cane or guide dog is most likely:

options.text: A person doing a traffic study.

questions.correctAnswerText: A blind person.
questions.explanation: You must always yield to a blind pedestrian who is using a white cane or guide dog.

questions.question: What should you do before you turn?
questions.correctAnswerText: Use your turn signal.
questions.explanation: Turn on your signal 3 to 4 seconds before you turn to alert other drivers.

questions.question: When you hear a fire engine siren behind you, what must you do?

options.text: Slow down until it passes you.
Pull over to the side of the road and stop.
Speed up and take the nearest exit.

questions.correctAnswerText: Pull over to the side of the road and stop.
questions.explanation: When you hear an emergency vehicle siren, pull over to the side of the road or curb and stop.

questions.question: What happens if you refuse an alcohol test when suspected of impaired driving?

options.text: It is your right and there are no penalties.
Your driver license will be suspended.
You will only get a fine.

questions.correctAnswerText: Your driver license will be suspended.
questions.explanation: When you drive a vehicle, you consent to an alcohol test. You cannot be forced to take the test, but your driver license will be immediately suspended if you refuse.

questions.question: If a train is close or moving fast enough to be dangerous, you must:

options.text: Slow down and proceed with caution.
Wait until the train completely passes before crossing.
Cross the tracks at your own risk.
Find another route across the tracks.

questions.correctAnswerText: Wait until the train completely passes before crossing.
questions.explanation: Look and listen for trains before crossing railroad tracks. If a train is close or moving fast, do not cross. This applies even if there are no signals or the signals are broken.

questions.question: When should you not pass another vehicle?

options.text: When school bus lights are flashing.

questions.correctAnswerText: All of the above.
questions.explanation: Never pass if an oncoming vehicle is in your lane, if hills or curves block your view, at intersections, before or on railroad crossings or bridges, or in any no passing zone. Do not pass a school bus with flashing red lights unless you are on the opposite side of a divided road.

questions.question: What helps prevent fatigue on long drives?

options.text: Stop and rest every two hours.
Drive with one eye open at a time.
Alternate feet on the gas pedal.

questions.correctAnswerText: Stop and rest every two hours.
questions.explanation: On long trips, stop every two hours for a short break. If you feel drowsy, pull off the road safely to nap or find a place to stay for the night.

questions.question: What should you do when an emergency vehicle with flashing red or blue lights approaches?

options.text: Try to reach your destination before it catches you.
Keep driving but try to stay out of its way.
Pull to the side of the road and stop completely.
Stop in the middle of an intersection.

questions.correctAnswerText: Pull to the side of the road and stop completely.
questions.explanation: You must yield to all emergency vehicles using sirens, air horns, or flashing red, blue, or white lights. Pull to the right edge of the road when possible. If you are in an intersection, drive through it first before pulling over.

questions.question: You arrive at an uncontrolled intersection at the same time as a vehicle to your right. What should you do?

options.text: Speed up and go through the intersection.
Slow down and let the vehicle on your right go first.
Drive through and make the other vehicle stop.
Honk your horn and drive through.

questions.correctAnswerText: Slow down and let the vehicle on your right go first.
questions.explanation: When two vehicles reach an intersection at the same time, the vehicle on the right has the right-of-way. Wait for it to pass safely before you go.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.correctAnswerText: Deer crossing.
questions.explanation: This sign warns that deer cross the road in this area. Slow down, stay alert, and be ready to stop.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.correctAnswerText: Hill ahead.
questions.explanation: This sign warns of a steep hill ahead.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.correctAnswerText: No U-turn.
questions.explanation: This sign prohibits U-turns. Do not make a U-turn where this sign is posted.

questions.question: How can you make sure your physical condition does not cause unsafe driving?

options.text: Stay physically fit and have regular check-ups.
Know how medicines affect your driving.

questions.correctAnswerText: All of the above.
questions.explanation: Your physical condition affects your ability to drive safely. Know your physical limits and only drive when it is safe.

questions.question: What is safe when crossing railroad tracks?

options.text: Look both ways only when the red light is flashing.
Listen, look both ways, and cross only if it is safe.
Cross very quickly when a train is approaching.
Quickly pass under any lowering gates.

questions.correctAnswerText: Listen, look both ways, and cross only if it is safe.
questions.explanation: Railroad crossings are always dangerous. Look and listen for trains from both directions before crossing. Watch for warning signals and never cross until you are sure it is safe.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.correctAnswerText: Side road.
questions.explanation: Warning signs are yellow with black markings. They alert drivers to upcoming road conditions and hazards. This sign tells you that traffic may enter from a side road ahead.

questions.question: When you signal before turning, changing lanes, or pulling away from a curb:

options.text: You only need to signal if other cars are nearby.
It is a good habit and the law requires it.
You only need to signal during the move, not before.
You do not need to signal if you move slowly.

questions.correctAnswerText: It is a good habit and the law requires it.
questions.explanation: Signal your intentions well before turning or changing lanes. The law requires you to signal for at least 100 feet before moving right or left. Always signal before pulling away from a curb to warn other drivers.

questions.question: What can happen when alcohol is mixed with another drug?

options.text: Both the alcohol and drug effects can become stronger.
Both the alcohol and drug effects can become weaker.
Only the alcohol effects can become weaker.

questions.correctAnswerText: Both the alcohol and drug effects can become stronger.
questions.explanation: Mixing alcohol with another drug can make both effects stronger. For example, one drink combined with a cold medicine can affect you like you had several drinks.

questions.question: When should you look over your shoulder to check your blind spot?

options.text: When pulling toward or away from a curb.

questions.correctAnswerText: All of the above.
questions.explanation: Check your blind spot every time you change your vehicle's position. Look over your shoulder when turning, changing lanes, or pulling toward or away from a curb.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?

options.text: A series of curves is ahead.
The road will be slippery when wet.

questions.correctAnswerText: The road will be slippery when wet.
questions.explanation: This sign warns that the road becomes slippery when it is wet.

questions.question: What happens to drivers who have consumed alcohol before driving?

options.text: They are always aware of the risks they are taking.
They lose control over their bodies, minds, and vehicles.
They become better drivers because they are more careful.

questions.correctAnswerText: They lose control over their bodies, minds, and vehicles.
questions.explanation: Alcohol is a depressant that harms judgment, vision, concentration, and reaction time. It is never safe to drink any amount of alcohol before driving.

questions.question: What does a yellow and black diamond-shaped sign tell you?

options.text: It warns you about conditions on or near the road.
It helps direct you to cities and towns ahead.
It tells you about traffic laws and rules.
It tells you about road construction ahead.

questions.correctAnswerText: It warns you about conditions on or near the road.
questions.explanation: Warning signs are diamond-shaped with black symbols or words on a yellow background. They alert you to conditions on or near the road ahead.
